title: Go Fast is a wind-blown balloon

tellings.quote: So my hypothesis about this one is that it's uh probably just a windb blown object like a balloon.

plain: The Go Fast video, a 2015 Navy recording off Jacksonville, Florida that seems to show a small object racing low over the ocean, probably shows nothing more than something like a balloon drifting with the wind. That is the view of Mick West, a well-known skeptic who analyses UFO videos, who says on Michels's show that his hypothesis is that it is "probably just a wind blown object like a balloon." If he is right, the object's apparent speed is an illusion of the camera angle.
